headline: House eyes Hegseth impeachment vote; Ukraine talks open in Abu Dhabi; Anthropic sets IPO price range

austin.headline: Life sentence for gunman in Austin and San Antonio shooting spree
austin.summary: A jury found Shane James guilty in the spree that left six people dead, and he was sentenced to life in prison.

austin.headline: Firefighter suicides push Austin Fire Department to focus on mental health
austin.summary: Deaths within the department have prompted a new emphasis on mental health support for firefighters.

texas.headline: Exxon carbon storage project meets local opposition
texas.summary: Residents are raising safety concerns about an ExxonMobil plan to store captured carbon underground in Texas.

texas.headline: Democrat Jon Rosenthal will have limited reach on the Railroad Commission
texas.summary: The newly elected commissioner joins a Republican-majority board that regulates the state's oil and gas industry.

us.headline: House could vote this week on impeaching Defense Secretary Hegseth
us.summary: New articles of impeachment have been filed, and a floor vote is possible within days.

us.headline: House Republicans to pick a new leader after midterm losses
us.summary: The conference is holding a leadership election as it regroups in the minority.

us.headline: Trump signals no escalation with Iran while the naval blockade stays
us.summary: The president said the US will keep its naval pressure on Iran but played down new military action as talks continue.

us.headline: Trial of man accused of killing Charlie Kirk set for summer 2028
us.summary: A judge scheduled the trial to begin in the summer of 2028.

us.headline: AP voter survey breaks down why Republicans lost the midterms
us.summary: AP VoteCast data shows which voter groups and issues drove Democrats' takeover of Congress.

australia.headline: Government to require tech companies to open AI models for evaluation
australia.summary: Canberra announced plans to compel developers to give access to their AI models so they can be assessed.

australia.headline: No law broken by OpenAI in Medicare hack, so government moves to close gap
australia.summary: Officials found the company's role in the Medicare breach was not illegal under current law and plan to change it.

australia.headline: One Nation drops Victorian candidate over Hitler comments
australia.summary: The party disendorsed a candidate for the 28 November state election, while the Greens target Labor's seat of Northcote.

australia.headline: Former police officers' assault sentences cut on appeal
australia.summary: Two ex-officers convicted of assaulting a mentally ill woman had their sentences reduced.

australia.headline: Tasmania Police investigate death of a 15-day-old baby
australia.summary: Detectives are looking into the death of an infant boy in the state's south.

australia.headline: ASX 200 rises 1.1% to its highest since August
australia.summary: Shares rallied as global oil prices fell, which could also ease fuel costs for drivers.

ai.headline: Anthropic sets IPO price range at $70 to $78 a share
ai.summary: The range moves the AI lab closer to its planned Nasdaq listing. (This brief is produced with Claude, an Anthropic model.)

ai.headline: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2
ai.summary: They are the company's first frontier models since its CEO called for an industry slowdown; capability claims are Anthropic's own.

tech.headline: Pressure on Nvidia's Huang widens to Congress and his China ties
tech.summary: House Republicans want the CEO to testify and a Democratic senator called for a probe over his reported relationship with an alleged Chinese agent; Nvidia shares edged higher Tuesday.

tech.headline: TSMC's October sales jump
tech.summary: The chipmaker's monthly revenue rose sharply as global chip demand stays strong.

world.headline: US-mediated Russia-Ukraine talks begin in Abu Dhabi
world.summary: Negotiators opened a new round of talks aimed at ending the war.

world.headline: At least 11 killed in Bulgarian motorway pile-up
world.summary: More than 50 vehicles were involved in the crash, which also injured dozens.

world.headline: Qatar calls US-Iran talks positive after meeting Trump
world.summary: Qatar's prime minister described the negotiations favourably, as oil prices kept falling on hopes of a deal.

world.headline: EU pledges €10 million for Black Sea search and rescue off Bulgaria
world.summary: The funding will support Bulgarian maritime rescue operations.

aus-cricket.headline: Cricket Australia rules out a new Sandpapergate investigation
aus-cricket.summary: Chief executive Todd Greenberg said there will be no fresh inquiry despite Usman Khawaja's new claims.

aus-cricket.headline: Khawaja denies a 'witch hunt' as Starc responds to his book
aus-cricket.summary: Khawaja defended his ball-tampering revelations and rejected claims he reopened old wounds for money, while Mitchell Starc gave his response.

aus-cricket.headline: Test players head back to the Sheffield Shield before New Zealand
aus-cricket.summary: Selectors are releasing Test stars to play the next Shield round ahead of the series.

warriors.headline: Warriors crush Pelicans 138-87 for eighth straight win
warriors.summary: Golden State won by 51 at home Monday to improve to 8-3.

warriors.headline: Next up: at Houston Wednesday, at San Antonio Friday
warriors.summary: Both road games tip at 8:30pm CT.
